Thanks Sarah — good details. Looping in Grace (CS) and Monica (modeling) to propose a concise shortlist and a token-velocity plan. High level answers here, fuller plan to follow by tomorrow EOD:

- Shortlist (initial): 1) open-llm-13b-8k (good latency/cost for summarization), 2) redwood-chat-33b-16k (for long-context Q&A, high accuracy), 3) distilled-realtime-7b-8k (fallback / cost tier).
- Context windows: recommend 8k for summarization flow (allows some history) and 16k for Q&A. We can enable KV-prefix caching on document assets that are repeatedly queried (e.g., policy docs).
- Caching impact: expect ~20–35% per-token reduction on repeated-doc Q&A after warm-up.

We have two asks for your infra team: (1) a realistic representative sample of long Q&A payloads (a few examples) and (2) confirmation of SLA needs during the 2-hour peak window (p99 latency target).

Grace and Monica — can you take the workbook, run a quick token-velocity calc, and return a short table of peak qps vs. GPU pool sizing and estimated monthly token spend?

— Michael
Michael Grant
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference

Posted the first-pass sizing below (pulled from the workbook + a small synthetic traffic sim). Keeping it compact so the Clearline infra team can action.

Peak assumptions used:
- Peak active users: 90 -> peak QPS (user-facing summarization) = 90 * 0.6 = 54 QPS (assuming 60% of active users make a request/min)
- Long-Q&A share: 15% of calls -> long-Q&A peak QPS = 8 QPS
- Average tokens (round trip): summarization = 320 tokens; long-Q&A = 900 tokens

Sizing table (summary):
- open-llm-13b-8k: target throughput 45 tok/s per GPU -> summarization peak needs ~4 gpus; long-Q&A fallback for smaller loads (not ideal)
- redwood-chat-33b-16k: target throughput 110 tok/s per GPU -> handles long-Q&A on 1–2 gpus (recommended 2 for headroom)
- distilled-realtime-7b-8k: cheap fallback, ~80 tok/s per GPU -> 2 gpus for burst capacity

Monthly token estimate (conservative):
- Summarization path: 1M calls * 320 tokens = 320M tokens
- Long-Q&A path: 250k calls * 900 tokens = 225M tokens
- Total monthly tokens = 545M tokens

Monica notes: quantization to int8 on the 33b variant reduces GPU memory footprint and keeps latency tight for the Q&A flow; will include recommended quant profile in the final doc.

Action items for Clearline:
1) Share 10 sample long-Q&A payloads (raw).
2) Confirm p99 latency target (recommended <= 750ms for summarization, <=1200ms for Q&A).
3) Approve shortlist and cost guardrails (we'll map to cost estimates once you confirm sample payloads).

— Monica
Monica Patel
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
